title: X509: wrongly rejects cert without CDP if CRL contains IDP with name matching cert issuer
root_cause: Incomplete implementation of CRL scope checks in case an IDP is present in a CRL but no CDPs are present in the target cert.
reproduction_command: openssl verify -attime 1705520210 -trusted cacert.pem -crl_check -CRLfile crl-no-IDP.pem cert-no-CDP.pem cert-no-CDP.pem: OK
openssl verify -attime 1705520210 -trusted cacert.pem -crl_check -CRLfile crl-no-IDP.pem cert-with-CDP.pem cert-with-CDP.pem: OK
openssl verify -attime 1705520210 -trusted cacert.pem -crl_check -CRLfile crl-with-IDP.pem cert-with-CDP.pem cert-with-CDP.pem: OK

openssl verify -attime 1705520210 -trusted cacert.pem -crl_check -CRLfile crl-with-IDP.pem cert-no-CDP.pem CN=x509-check-test error 44 at 0 depth lookup: different CRL scope error cert-no-CDP.pem: verification failed

openssl verify -attime 1768585400 -trusted demoCA/cacert2.pem -crl_check -CRLfile demoCA/crl-with-macthing-IDP.pem demoCA/cert2-no-CDP.pem CN=x509-check-test2 error 44 at 0 depth lookup: different CRL scope error demoCA/cert2-no-CDP.pem: verification failed
validation_notes: The generated C harness was translated from an OpenSSL verify command using CRL checking. It compiled and executed with generated placeholder CA, end-entity certificate, and CRL inputs. Valgrind reported 0 errors. This validates the X509_STORE CRL verification API path, but does not strictly reproduce the original issue because the original CA/CRL/certificate inputs have not been recovered.
